<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Match-3</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#1a1033;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1a1033ee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;width:min(90vw,340px)}
button{background:#ec4899;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700}button:disabled{background:#35285a;color:#8a7cb5}
</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=20,K='mg_match3',T='🍬 Match-3',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Vuốt hoặc chạm hai ô kề nhau để đổi chỗ, ghép 3 ô giống nhau trở lên. Xoá đủ số ô trước khi hết lượt':'Kéo chuột hoặc click hai ô kề nhau để đổi chỗ, ghép 3 ô giống nhau trở lên. Xoá đủ số ô trước khi hết lượt';
let W,H,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w,t){if(!run)return;draw();run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:t||'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);lt=t;if(run){upd(d);if(run)draw()}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
const EJ=['🍓','🍋','🍇','🍏','🍊','🥥'];let R,nt,B,M,ph,tm,cl,goal,mv,sel,dn,s,ox,oy;
function fill(){B=Array.from({length:R},()=>Array(R).fill(0));for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let q=0;q<R;q++){let v;do v=Math.random()*nt|0;while((q>1&&B[r][q-1]==v&&B[r][q-2]==v)||(r>1&&B[r-1][q]==v&&B[r-2][q]==v));B[r][q]=v}}
function sw(r,q,r2,q2){const t=B[r][q];B[r][q]=B[r2][q2];B[r2][q2]=t}
function mt(){const S=new Set();for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let q=0;q<R;q++){const v=B[r][q];if(v<0)continue;if(q<R-2&&B[r][q+1]==v&&B[r][q+2]==v)[0,1,2].forEach(k=>S.add(r*R+q+k));if(r<R-2&&B[r+1][q]==v&&B[r+2][q]==v)[0,1,2].forEach(k=>S.add((r+k)*R+q))}return S}
function hm(){for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let q=0;q<R;q++)for(const[a,b]of[[0,1],[1,0]]){if(r+a>=R||q+b>=R)continue;sw(r,q,r+a,q+b);const k=mt().size;sw(r,q,r+a,q+b);if(k)return 1}return 0}
function gr(){for(let q=0;q<R;q++){const col=[];for(let r=R-1;r>=0;r--)if(B[r][q]>=0)col.push(B[r][q]);while(col.length<R)col.push(Math.random()*nt|0);for(let r=0;r<R;r++)B[R-1-r][q]=col[r]}}
function init(){R=6+((lv-1)>>3);nt=4+((lv-1)>>3);goal=12+lv*3;mv=20;cl=0;ph=0;M=new Set();sel=dn=null;do fill();while(!hm())}
function tryS(a,b){if(ph||!run)return;sw(a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1]);M=mt();if(!M.size){sw(a[0],a[1],b[0],b[1]);return}mv--;ph=1;tm=.2}
function upd(d){if(!ph)return;tm-=d;if(tm>0)return;if(ph==1){cl+=M.size;M.forEach(i=>B[i/R|0][i%R]=-1);gr();M=new Set();ph=2;tm=.18}else{M=mt();if(M.size){ph=1;tm=.2}else{ph=0;if(cl>=goal)end(1);else if(mv<=0)end(0);else if(!hm()){do fill();while(!hm())}}}}
function draw(){s=Math.min((W-16)/R,(H-90)/R);ox=(W-R*s)/2;oy=(H-R*s)/2+8;C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);C.font=s*.7+'px serif';C.textAlign='center';C.textBaseline='middle';
for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let q=0;q<R;q++){const x=ox+q*s,y=oy+r*s;C.globalAlpha=1;C.fillStyle=sel&&sel[0]==r&&sel[1]==q?'#6d4ccf':'#2a2147';C.beginPath();C.roundRect(x+2,y+2,s-4,s-4,8);C.fill();if(B[r][q]>=0){C.globalAlpha=M.has(r*R+q)?.3:1;C.fillText(EJ[B[r][q]],x+s/2,y+s/2+2)}}
C.globalAlpha=1;h.textContent=`Màn ${lv} · ${Math.min(cl,goal)}/${goal} ô · Còn ${mv} lượt`}
function cell(x,y){const q=Math.floor((x-ox)/s),r=Math.floor((y-oy)/s);return q>=0&&q<R&&r>=0&&r<R?[r,q]:null}
c.onpointerdown=e=>{if(!run||ph)return;const p=cell(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(!p)return;if(sel&&Math.abs(sel[0]-p[0])+Math.abs(sel[1]-p[1])==1){const a=sel;sel=null;dn=null;tryS(a,p);return}dn={p,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}};
c.onpointermove=e=>{if(!dn||ph)return;const dx=e.clientX-dn.x,dy=e.clientY-dn.y;if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))>s*.45){const[r,q]=dn.p,[a,b]=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?[0,dx>0?1:-1]:[dy>0?1:-1,0],r2=r+a,q2=q+b;dn=null;sel=null;if(r2>=0&&r2<R&&q2>=0&&q2<R)tryS([r,q],[r2,q2])}};
onpointerup=onpointercancel=()=>{if(dn){const p=dn.p;sel=sel&&sel[0]==p[0]&&sel[1]==p[1]?null:p}dn=null};
menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
